_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Driver cancellations & no-shows
categories.description: Drivers cancel, don't move, refuse destinations or no-show.

categories.name: Drivers demanding extra cash
categories.description: Asking for extra money, AC charges, cash only, off-app fares.

categories.name: Surge & fares higher than shown
categories.description: Surge pricing, final fare above estimate, high prices.

categories.name: Safety & harassment
categories.description: Rash or drunk driving, harassment, unsafe late-night rides.

categories.name: No cabs & long waits
categories.description: No drivers available, long ETAs at peak hours.

categories.name: Cancellation fees, payments & refunds
categories.description: Unfair cancellation fees, wrong charges, refunds.

categories.name: Lost items
categories.description: Things left in the car and hard to recover.

categories.name: App & booking glitches
categories.description: App crashes, booking failures, GPS and map problems.

categories.name: Account bans & blocks
categories.description: Rider accounts blocked or banned, often without explanation.

categories.name: Complaints & customer support
categories.description: No human support, hard to complain or escalate.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Daily commuter
personas.description: Uses rides to get to work.

personas.name: Driver / captain
keywords: i('m| am) a driver|as a driver|captain|my rating as driver|drive for
